sections.heading: Algorithm analysis in Data Structures and Algorithms
paragraphs: Algorithm analysis is studied here as a specific part of Data Structures and Algorithms. Begin by defining the term precisely and identifying the problem it helps explain or solve. Keep the scope narrow: related ideas may interact with it, but they are not interchangeable.

examples.title: Worked application: Algorithm analysis
steps: Asymptotic analysis describes how resource use grows with input size, abstracting away machine-specific constants. Big-O is an upper-bound notation; it is not automatically the exact running time. Analyse the dominant operation, state the case being measured, and account for nested loops, recursion, and auxiliary memory.

practiceQuestions.prompt: If an algorithm examines every pair in a list of n items using two full nested loops, what is the usual time order?
options: O(n²)
O(log n)
O(n log log n)
practiceQuestions.explanation: Two nested loops each scaling with n generally produce a quadratic number of iterations.
